docs.title: Ultimate Complexion Besties
docs.subtitle:
On-the-Glow BASE 
• "One swipe of this tinted moisturizer in a stick instantly perfects complexion & deeply hydrates.”- Petra
• Infused with dewy flattering pigment, meaning that you can create a base that enhances and perfects in one sweep, to make you look like you are wearing no makeup!
• Unique, sheer, nourishing and protecting base that feels much lighter & more breathable than a traditional foundation.
• Use all-over on bare skin or specifically in areas where more coverage is needed.
• Suitable for all skin types
• Available in a broad spectrum of 18 new shades. Use a single shade or blend 2 for a bespoke shade match.
• Vegan
• Not tested on animals
• Volume: 0.6 oz / 19g

Flawless Beauty Primer 
• "This keeps dry skin hydrated, adds a lit-from-within glow, and evens out skintone perfectly!" - Petra 
• Even, flawless skin tone is the sign of youthful healthy skin
• This primer is the perfect solution; the formula is loaded with skin-loving ingredients
• Formula contains powerful anti-aging and skin fortifying benefits
• Suitable for all skin types
• Paraben-free
• Not tested on animals
• Volume: 30 ml / 1 fl. oz

On-the Glow BLUSH Petite 
• “This petite blush is proof that good things really do come in small, glow-filled packages.”- Petra 
• Hydrating solid cheek tint.
• Use on cheeks & lips.
• Vitamin packed for antioxidant benefits.
• One sweep colour payoff.
• Complements all skin tones
• Paraben-free
• Vegan
• Not tested on animals.
• Volume: 0.3oz / 10g
